registered_outcome_tree.DENSITY_LINKED_INDIVIDUALIZATION_CONVERG: Both primary directions pass independently in both families and all three backbones. Treat density-linked convergence as the working explanation of the E=10 boundary while preserving the failed original conjunction.
registered_outcome_tree.FAMILY_OR_BACKBONE_SPECIFIC_INDIVIDUALIZ: At least one primary direction passes in at least one analysis, but none of the three replicated outcomes above holds. Retain heterogeneity and do not average it away.
registered_outcome_tree.NONINTERPRETABLE_SOURCE: Any source hash, expected cell count, participant alignment, finite-value, order-permutation, or decomposition-identity gate fails. Repair execution without changing estimands or reading a new neural output.
registered_outcome_tree.NO_REPLICATED_DENSITY_LOCALIZATION: Neither primary direction passes in any analysis. Treat the E=10 miss as unlocalized rather than evidence for convergence.
registered_outcome_tree.ORDER_CONVERGENCE_WITHOUT_REPLICATED_STA: Pairwise-tau slope passes in all six family-backbone analyses but stable-error incidence does not. Density makes rankings more similar without a fully replicated loss of stable error incidence.
registered_outcome_tree.STABLE_ERROR_LOSS_WITHOUT_REPLICATED_ORD: Stable-error incidence slope passes in all six analyses but pairwise-tau slope does not. Density reduces stable errors without a fully replicated convergence of whole orders.

registered_primary_estimands.all_participant_pairwise_tau_slope: At each density, compute the mean pairwise Kendall tau among all 77 stored subjective orders, without conditioning on ranking class. Under each paired participant bootstrap draw, use the same resampling counts at all four densities and the standard weighted pairwise-tau formula, then compute the OLS slope over E. Positive values indicate cross-subject order convergence as density rises.
registered_primary_estimands.replication_unit: Each estimand must pass separately within each family and backbone. Never pool participant rows or bootstrap draws across families or networks.
registered_primary_estimands.stable_error_incidence_slope: For each of all 77 participants, define I80(E)=1 if stable_error_pair_counts['80'] is positive and zero otherwise, including correct rankers as zero. Compute the participant's OLS slope across E={7,8,9,10}; summarize the paired participant slopes. Negative values indicate fewer participants with stable errors as density rises.
